classDiagram
    direction LR

    class BootstrapProtocolPortV1 {
        <<interface>>
        +BeginBootstrapChallenge()
        +QueryActivationCapability(BuildProvenanceV1, LocalBuildEnrollmentV1)
        +PrepareManagedLocalEnrollment(ManagedLocalEnrollmentRequestV1)
        +SubmitRepairActivationBaton(RepairActivationBatonV1)
        +SubmitBootstrapCommand(BootstrapCommandV1)
        +ReadBootstrapResult(ActivationId)
    }
    class ProfilePreflightPortV1 {
        <<interface>>
        +ClassifyBuildOrigin(BuildProvenanceV1)
        +InspectEnrollment(LocalBuildEnrollmentV1)
        +InspectCapabilities(VerifiedBuildSlotV1)
        +BuildEnrollmentPlan(ManagedLocalEnrollmentRequestV1)
        +BuildActivationPlan(PlatformCapabilityReportV1)
    }
    class ActivationJournalPortV1 {
        <<interface>>
        +AcquireSingleFlight(EnrollmentIdOrActivationId)
        +AppendEnrollmentIntent(ManagedLocalEnrollmentRequestV1)
        +AppendEnrollmentObservation(EnrollmentJournalMutationV1)
        +StoreEnrollmentPrepared(EnrollmentPreparedV1)
        +AppendEffectIntent(BootstrapJournalMutationV1)
        +AppendObservedEffect(BootstrapJournalMutationV1)
        +AdvancePhase(BootstrapPhaseV1)
        +StoreManualRecoveryNotice(ManualRecoveryNoticeV1)
        +StoreBootstrapResult(BootstrapResultV1)
        +LoadRecoveryState(EnrollmentIdOrActivationId)
    }
    class BuildSlotVerifyPortV1 {
        <<interface>>
        +VerifyStagedArtifact(BuildArtifactRefV1)
        +PrepareLocalEnrollment(BuildArtifactRefV1, BuildProvenanceV1)
        +OpenVerifiedSlot(BuildContentHash)
        +ReverifyOpenedSlot(OpenBuildSlotHandleV1)
    }
    class PlatformActivationPortV1 {
        <<interface>>
        +ObserveActiveSelector(ActivationPlanV1)
        +ApplyCandidateSelector(ActivationPlanV1)
        +RestorePreviousSelector(ActivationPlanV1)
        +VerifySelector(ActivationId)
    }
    class ApplicationLaunchWatchdogPortV1 {
        <<interface>>
        +CleanupProcessTree(ProcessGenerationV1)
        +LaunchGeneration(ProcessGenerationV1)
        +AwaitIdentityHandshake(ProcessGenerationV1)
        +AwaitFocusedVerification(ProcessGenerationV1)
    }
    class ActivationControlPortV1 {
        <<interface>>
        +PrepareManagedLocalEnrollment(ManagedLocalEnrollmentRequestV1)
        +StartAdmittedActivation(BootstrapCommandV1)
        +RecoverActivation(BootstrapRecoveryStateV1)
    }
    class ProtocolGateway
    class ActivationJournal
    class ImmutableBuildSlotManager
    class ManagedLocalBuildProfileV1Adapter
    class ApplicationLaunchWatchdog
    class ActivationRollbackCoordinator
    class BuildProvenanceV1 {
        +BuildOriginV1 origin
        +BuildId buildId
        +VcsRevision revision
        +Hash dirtyTreeDigest
        +Hash dependencyLockDigest
        +TargetTriple target
        +Hash toolchainDigest
        +VersionRange helperProtocol
    }
    class LocalBuildEnrollmentV1 {
        +InstallationId installationId
        +Hash managedRootIdentity
        +Hash helperAndLauncherHash
        +Hash selectorIdentity
        +Hash activeBundleHash
        +IntegrityStrengthV1 integrity
    }
    class ManagedLocalEnrollmentRequestV1 {
        +EnrollmentId enrollmentId
        +Hash provenanceDigest
        +ArtifactId wholeBundleArtifact
        +Hash expectedBundleHash
    }
    class EnrollmentPreparedV1 {
        +EnrollmentId enrollmentId
        +InstallationId installationId
        +Hash managedRootIdentity
        +Hash launcherHash
        +Hash initialActiveBundleHash
    }
    class ManualRecoveryNoticeV1 {
        +ActivationId activationId
        +ReasonCodeV1 reason
        +Hash observedSlotState
        +DiagnosticId diagnosticId
    }
    class PlatformCapabilityReportV1 {
        +BuildOriginV1 origin
        +LocalBuildEnrollmentStateV1 enrollment
        +ActivationEligibilityV1 eligibility
        +ReasonCodeV1 reason
        +Hash capabilityGeneration
        +IntegrityStrengthV1 integrity
    }
    class RepairActivationBatonV1 {
        +ActivationId activationId
        +Hash approvalAndDisclosureHash
        +ManagementCheckpointRefV1 managementCheckpoint
        +Hash capabilityGeneration
        +Hash candidateBuildHash
        +Hash previousBuildHash
        +ProcessGenerationV1 currentGeneration
        +ProcessGenerationV1 candidateGeneration
        +Hash verificationPlanDigest
    }
    class BootstrapCommandV1 {
        +CommandId commandId
        +ActivationId activationId
        +ProcessGenerationV1 generation
        +BootstrapCommandKindV1 kind
        +CapabilityOutcomeV1 verificationOutcome
    }
    class BootstrapResultV1 {
        +ActivationId activationId
        +BootstrapDispositionV1 disposition
        +Hash finalSlotHash
        +ProcessGenerationV1 nextCoreGeneration
        +Hash journalHeadHash
        +ReceiptIntegrityV1 integrity
    }

    BootstrapProtocolPortV1 <|.. ProtocolGateway
    ProfilePreflightPortV1 <|.. ManagedLocalBuildProfileV1Adapter
    ActivationJournalPortV1 <|.. ActivationJournal
    BuildSlotVerifyPortV1 <|.. ImmutableBuildSlotManager
    PlatformActivationPortV1 <|.. ManagedLocalBuildProfileV1Adapter
    ApplicationLaunchWatchdogPortV1 <|.. ApplicationLaunchWatchdog
    ActivationControlPortV1 <|.. ActivationRollbackCoordinator

    ProtocolGateway --> ManagedLocalEnrollmentRequestV1 : bounds and authenticates
    ActivationRollbackCoordinator --> EnrollmentPreparedV1 : emits after durable preparation
    ApplicationLaunchWatchdog --> ManualRecoveryNoticeV1 : produces when no core can launch
    ProtocolGateway --> BuildProvenanceV1 : validates
    ProtocolGateway --> LocalBuildEnrollmentV1 : validates
    ProtocolGateway --> PlatformCapabilityReportV1 : returns and binds
    ProtocolGateway --> RepairActivationBatonV1 : authenticates and fences
    ProtocolGateway --> BootstrapCommandV1 : validates
    ProtocolGateway --> ActivationJournalPortV1 : durably admits and reads result
    ProtocolGateway --> BuildSlotVerifyPortV1 : preflights exact hashes
    ProtocolGateway --> ProfilePreflightPortV1 : requires Supported
    ProtocolGateway --> ActivationControlPortV1 : prepares enrollment or starts and recovers admitted activation
    ImmutableBuildSlotManager --> LocalBuildEnrollmentV1 : materializes initial managed slot
    ActivationRollbackCoordinator --> ActivationJournalPortV1 : intent observation and phase
    ActivationRollbackCoordinator --> BuildSlotVerifyPortV1 : candidate and previous
    ActivationRollbackCoordinator --> PlatformActivationPortV1 : switch and restore
    ActivationRollbackCoordinator --> ApplicationLaunchWatchdogPortV1 : cleanup launch and verify
    ActivationRollbackCoordinator --> BootstrapResultV1 : emits protected receipt

    note for ManagedLocalBuildProfileV1Adapter "V1 has no packaged selector, elevation, package-manager, updater, or force path."
    note for ImmutableBuildSlotManager "Direct cargo dev and mutable target output are not activation slots."
    note for ActivationJournal "Same-user hash and ownership integrity; no publisher-authentication claim."
    note for ActivationRollbackCoordinator "Receipt is not Chat history. The next trusted core commits evidence and resumes Management Chat."
